summary: Dairy-free swap guide: Whole-milk yogurt → Coconut yogurt, Butter → Vegan butter, Heavy cream → Coconut cream, Heavy cream → Soy cooking cream

instagram_carousel.text:
The ingredient swaps were the easy part of making this tikka masala dairy-free. What matters is what you do differently with each one: stir the coconut yogurt smooth, let it drip so the chicken chars, whisk the coconut cream and keep it at a gentle simmer. Real RecipeFix result (captured 2026-10-21), scaled 4 to 6 servings. The starting recipe is a RecipeFix Original, an AI-written home recipe. Save this for your next dairy-free curry.

thread: Coconut yogurt for whole-milk yogurt: Stir the coconut yogurt smooth before coating the chicken; a thick, cultured variety clings better than a thin yogurt. Let excess coconut yogurt drip off so the coating chars rather than pools.
Vegan butter for butter: Check that the vegan butter contains no milk derivatives.
Coconut cream for heavy cream: Whisk separated coconut cream smooth before adding and keep the sauce at a gentle simmer. Choose plain unsweetened coconut cream, not sweetened cream of coconut.
Soy cooking cream for heavy cream: Keep the sauce at a gentle simmer rather than a hard boil after adding soy cooking cream.
Starting recipe: a RecipeFix Original, an AI-written home recipe. Real RecipeFix result, captured Oct 21, 2026.
